messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: 1783456789 - anomaly detected: hosted-inference v2 region-us-west latency spike + 502s on structured-output handlers. Alert group: inference-availability. Auto-annotated: increased error rate for tool-invoke endpoints (fnInvoke) and for structured-json endpoint (jsonEmit).

Mira (oncall): seeing the spike on grafana. 99th jump from 220ms -> 2.8s in last 3m. rate of fnInvoke errors up ~6x.

Alex K: yep, reproduced locally hitting /v2/generate?mode=structured with high token lengths. KV cache thrash + some OOMs in worker logs.

Samir P: are premium/dedicated customers affected or only hosted?

Mira (oncall): mostly hosted public pool (hosted-usw). Dedicated customers not impacted per initial telemetry. one low-volume enterprise customer reported truncated json responses — @Emily S can you check support queue?

Emily S: I have a ticket from AcmeCorp saying "json payloads partial/invalid". Marked P2, waiting for status update.

Jordan L: quick mitigation options: 1) globally disable structured-json mode on hosted pool, 2) block fnInvoke (tool calls) for new requests, 3) ramp stricter rate limits on public keys (per-key qps reduction). Suggest combination: disable structured-json + soft deny tool calls for 10m while we stabilize.

Mira (oncall): agree with combo. Structured JSON has heavier postprocessing and locks. Tool calls cause external network waits. Priority is to reduce tail latency.

Alex K: plan: - push runtime flag to reject jsonEmit with 503 + human-readable fallback; - update gateway to respond 429 for fnInvoke for public-tier keys at >2rps; - exclude dedicated/premium keys from this path.

Samir P: do we need to update rate limit tokens in the edge? I can patch rate-limiter config and rollout 10s canary then global.

Mira (oncall): do it. Samir, start canary in us-west-1 at +2min. Jordan and Alex please prepare rollback commands.

ops-bot: deploy-trigger: rate-limiter-config v2026-03-15-rlc-3 queued by Samir P. Canary group: 5% public keys in us-west-1.

Alex K: runtime flag command: 
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/flags/runtime -d '{"hosted:structured_json": "disabled"}'
```
I'll run that on the hosted pool after canary hits.

Mira (oncall): note for comms: add a status page incident that structured-output and tool-calls may return 429/503 intermittently for hosted API. Emily, can you draft a short note for support?

Emily S: drafting now. pinging AcmeCorp with targeted note.

ops-bot: rate-limiter-config v2026-03-15-rlc-3: canary deployed to us-west-1 - 5% traffic.

Samir P: canary is green (5m). latency back down 40% on those keys. error-rate for fnInvoke down. rolling to 50% now.

Jordan L: pushing structured-json disable flag to 10% first.

Alex K: flag pushed to 10% -> observing reduced KV thrash and fewer long tail IO waits. Will push to 100% in 2m if stable.

Mira (oncall): proceed. keep dedicated/premium excluded from rate change. Document exact key exclusions in the incident notes.

ops-bot: runtime-flag update: hosted:structured_json=disabled - rollout 10% -> success.

Samir P: rolling rate-limiter to 100% now.

Alex K: runtime flag at 100% now. Structured-mode disabled for hosted public pool. Confirming responses now return simple text fallback with 503 code and retry guidance in body.

Mira (oncall): good. initial metrics show 95th latency back to baseline, 99th improving. Error budget burn stopped.

Emily S: support note sent to AcmeCorp and posted in status page: "We are throttling function/tool calls and disabling structured-output on hosted API in US-West to mitigate high latency. Dedicated customers unaffected. Working on full restoration."

Jordan L: follow-ups: - collect sample stack traces from runtime where fnInvoke previously spiked - run deeper mem/proc scan on affected worker instances - add temporary quota rule so new keys hit lower default until auto-scaling backlog cleared.

Mira (oncall): assigning tasks: Alex - traces + rollback runbook; Samir - rate-limiter audit + revert plan; Jordan - worker memory scan; Emily - stakeholder comms + support ticket updates. I'll stay on this thread for 30m then handoff to Eng-Runtime for overnight.

Eng-Runtime: I'm taking the handoff at 1783456930. Mira, status please?

Mira (oncall): handing off: mitigations active (structured-output disabled on hosted; fnInvoke rate limiter enforced for public keys). Latency improving, error-rate decreasing. No dedicated customer impact. Documented rollback steps at https://internal.link/incident/1783456789/runbook (internal).

Eng-Runtime: acknowledged. I'll monitor until 1783457050 and then escalate if regressions. Please post any new customer reports here.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 1783456789 - mitigations applied (structured-output disabled, fnInvoke rate limits). Severity: Sev-2 -> monitoring.

Mira (oncall): closing active mitigation window in 30m if stable. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
